finding: f3 . a returns list containing a; run-f3 calls with zero to four args; retained expected C contains generic GET_REST
hazard: Expected C is static source, not current-host build or proof that every specialized call takes generic/slow entry
proposedReplacement: Use f3(0..3 logical ids) as bounded real contract, both generic dispatch and heap-limit trigger conditional

finding: Button command make-setter closure calls tcl; procedure arguments are exported, scheme_call_cmd -> tcltk_call -> apply invokes closure -> tcltk#tcl command . args
hazard: Generic rest slow path may be specialized away and GC pressure not forced; borrowed argv and original native frame still alive
proposedReplacement: Source-reachable callback/rest composition, not a recorded native execution; preserve synchronous result and stack

finding: targ-gen-label-entry derives required/optional/rest dispatch; GET_REST puts target in temp1 and jumps handler for nonnegative nargs
hazard: Rest reconstruction would repeat if restored nargs treated as fresh count
proposedReplacement: RestConstructionPlan separates original generic entry and resume sentinel; conditional source admission

finding: handler7 reads np/na, pushes register args; insufficient nargs shifts operator/args and tail raises wrong-nargs exception
hazard: Raw pending argument stack is not a complete continuation frame
proposedReplacement: Keep source construction lease and separate wrong-arity exit plan before rest pops

finding: CONS pops last pending arg and prepends it to local rest_param_list; decrements i
hazard: Unregistered C local list and partial stack cannot be frozen as if W_ALL covered them
proposedReplacement: Preserve pending-prefix plus built-suffix order and one pair per rest arg under noncollecting construction lease

finding: W_ALL -> heap_limit -> R_ALL; heap_limit adjusts msection/context or returns need-GC; actual GC is later
hazard: Replacing this helper with implicit GC/callback would expose unrooted locals/incomplete frames
proposedReplacement: Keep no-collection/no-managed-reentry effect contract; full helper/transitive origin proof remains open

finding: On need-GC finish every remaining CONS before any GC; bounded by actual args; no repeated limit check inside tail
hazard: Fudge constant alone does not prove enough physical words for all remaining pairs and vector
proposedReplacement: Preflight RepairCapacityReceipt with remaining*(2+PAIR_BODY)+np+VECTOR_BODY and actual physical interval; refuse before destructive start if unqualified

finding: Write vector header and last slot rest; pop required args into prior slots; END_ALLOC advances hp; push target and vector
hazard: Header publication or hp change is not fully initialized vector/root transfer
proposedReplacement: Keep no-park region through all np fields; publish typed completed packet only after initialized slots complete

finding: Helper stores R0,R1,R2 at stack slots1,2,3, installs return label2, adjusts fp by8 and calls gc-without-exceptions; return descriptor fs5/link0/gcmap7
hazard: Pushing proc/vector or completing vector alone is not a complete spill/frame receipt
proposedReplacement: FrameReady after actual call frame plus RA/W_ALL spill; verify current generator maps separately from retained C specimen

finding: mark_frame scans gcmap slots from1, mark_continuation decodes return metadata; gc helper saves RA/W_ALL and reloads after actual GC
hazard: Frozen SCMOBJ value copies or native raw aliases become stale after collector updates cells
proposedReplacement: Canonical updateable frame/register/native root handles plus post-copy reload

finding: Resume pops proc/vector, pushes vector fields in order, loads register args, jumps target with nargs=-1; GET_REST requires nargs>=0
hazard: Reentering ordinary native wrapper or generic nargs would reconstruct list and duplicate effects
proposedReplacement: Resume same packet and target after fresh epoch claim; zero new rest pairs due to resume

finding: GC overflow raises heap-overflow exception; returning handler retries with retained proc/args; nonreturn uses continuation exit
hazard: Overflow is not successful resume or permission to reinitialize packed args
proposedReplacement: Retain packet roots through handler/retry; model one chosen round only, cross-round attempt freshness remains open

finding: SFUN conversion/marker/call, marker kill and Tcl delete release distinct resources
hazard: Closing borrow admission does not revoke in-flight raw data_rc accesses or native result/code aliases
proposedReplacement: All-domain native root/borrow handles, exact same stack/catcher and final access completion; unknown duty retained

finding: Owned callback dequeues before execute; publisher touches PSTATE after unlock; RC root cell scanned by address only P0 branch
hazard: Empty queue or pointer generation does not exclude old writers/claimed callbacks or cover nonzero RC roots
proposedReplacement: Import complete writer/borrow census and all-domain adapter; accepted receipt must match last root generation

finding: Native call installs catcher; Scheme return tests processor/live marker and throws to own catcher; propagation may escape
hazard: Exit during scan could destroy root/stack backing; completed inner callback not outer native stop
proposedReplacement: Latch managed exit then same-owner guard after reader/round readiness; one terminal claim; raw forced longjmp rejects profile

finding: Strong/weak/cleanup/resize result then prepare fp/hp/limits, GC notice earlier; binding/resize cleanup have separate lifetime
hazard: Scan done, notification or failed/unknown join cannot recreate live original native stack
proposedReplacement: Whole-round/context/binding/root reload and fresh epoch permission; death/unknown owner retains debt and forbids same-call resume
